newsitem.title: USA: Calif. economy recovers but faces challenges - S&P.
newsitem.headline: Calif. economy recovers but faces challenges - S&P.

text.p: California's economy has recovered but the state still faces fiscal challenges, a senior Standard & Poor's analyst said Thursday.
"California's financial position today is not highly liquid," Steve Zimmermann, an S&P managing director, said during a panel discussion at a DRI/McGraw-Hill conference in San Francisco.
"The situation is definitely improving, but it will take a couple more years to build up larger reserves to guard against economic uncertainties," he said.
DRI/McGraw-Hill is a unit of Standard & Poor's, which is a division of McGraw-Hill Cos Inc.
